literal_meaning: এই দিক ওই দিক (this side that side)
figurative_meaning_bn: এদিক ওদিক ছড়িয়ে-ছিটিয়ে বা বিভিন্ন দিকে
figurative_meaning_en: scattered here and there or in different directions
example_sentences_in_bangla: বইগুলো এধার ওধার ছড়িয়ে পড়ে আছে।
example_sentences_in_english: The books are scattered here and there.
He is looking here and there in worry.
note: This idiom is a variant or dialectal form similar to the standard 'এদিক ওদিক', commonly used in spoken Bengali to indicate dispersion or aimless looking.
